reviewNotes: Reviewed all 97 speech keys against all 16 cards and explicit furigana in data/pages61-timing.json. Contextual topic/contrast は and では rendered わ; object を rendered お; directional 季節へ, 時期へ, 献立へ and 役割へ rendered え. Preserved lexical はしり, はつもの, はじまり, はじめて, はいる, はやめ, はな, はんだん and へんか. Preserved ならでは as the original expression. Checked しゅん, はしり, さかり, なごり, しんもの, こもの, しんのり, さいせいき, ぎょかく, さきどり, せいじゅくど, いっかいせい, かいいき and とうねん against source readings. Loanwords rendered in hiragana retaining long-vowel marks; sequence arrows rendered pauses. Display text and lookup keys unchanged. No listening or pitch-accent verification.
